tasks.spec:
You are a code-feature worker implementing Phase 10a (financial reports) of MonetaFox Reborn, a Microsoft Money replacement PWA at /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn (the REPO). Read plan-reborn.md (Phase 10) and spec.md (Reports & Dashboard) first. Phase 10 is split: THIS task (10a) is the reporting analytics + the Reports PAGE; the Dashboard is a later task (10b) — do NOT build the dashboard now. Reuse (do NOT reimplement): src/lib/currency/ (convertToBase(amount, from, base, rates) — rates[c] = base units per 1 unit of c; throws on missing rate — and formatCurrency), src/lib/accounts/ (accountBalance, netWorthInBase), src/lib/transactions/ (categoryTotals, filterTransactions — split-aware), src/lib/investments/ (portfolioValue, latestPrice), the stores (useAccountStore, useTransactionStore, useInvestmentStore, useSettingsStore for baseCurrency + rates), and Recharts (already installed).

CONVENTIONS (pinned by a hidden contract test): amounts are SIGNED (income +, expense −). All report figures are in the BASE currency, converting each transaction from its own currency via convertToBase. SPENDING reports include ONLY outflows (expenses), reported as POSITIVE totals, and are split-aware (a split line contributes to its own category). Income vs expenses: income = Σ positive (converted); expenses = Σ |negative| (converted); net = income − expenses. Net worth = Σ account balances converted to base (via netWorthInBase, excludes archived) PLUS the investment portfolio value (portfolioValue). Net worth over time evaluates net worth at each asOf date using only transactions dated <= that date (and prices dated <= that date).

BOUNDARY / OWNERSHIP: Edit directly in the REPO working tree. You OWN only: src/lib/reports/** (create), src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx (build the real page), and new src/components/reports/** files. Do NOT modify src/lib/db/**, crypto/auth, the stores, other pages, routes.tsx, Layout.tsx, App.tsx, the .md files, or .ringer/. Do NOT add dependencies. Do NOT git commit or push. (Read the stores; do not edit them.)

DELIVERABLE — implement with this EXACT public API (a hidden contract test pins it):
1. src/lib/reports/index.ts (pure, well-tested):
   - export function spendingByCategory(transactions: Transaction[], base: string, rates: Record<string, number>): { categoryId: string; total: number }[] — split-aware, expenses only, positive base totals; income categories excluded.
   - export function spendingByPayee(transactions: Transaction[], base: string, rates: Record<string, number>): { payee: string; total: number }[] — expenses only, positive base totals.
   - export function incomeVsExpenses(transactions: Transaction[], base: string, rates: Record<string, number>): { income: number; expenses: number; net: number }.
   - export function netWorth(accounts: Account[], transactions: Transaction[], holdings: Holding[], prices: PricePoint[], base: string, rates: Record<string, number>): number.
   - export function netWorthOverTime(accounts: Account[], transactions: Transaction[], holdings: Holding[], prices: PricePoint[], base: string, rates: Record<string, number>, asOfDates: string[]): { date: string; value: number }[].
   Reuse the existing currency/accounts/transactions/investments helpers; do not duplicate their logic.
2. src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx — a real Reports view reading accounts/transactions/holdings/prices from the stores and base currency + rates from useSettingsStore, with an optional date-range control, rendering: Net Worth (a number) and Net Worth Over Time (a Recharts line chart), Spending by Category (a Recharts pie or bar chart), Spending by Payee (a bar/list), and Income vs Expenses (a bar chart). Format money via formatCurrency. Handle the empty-data and missing-rate cases gracefully (a foreign amount with no rate should surface a clear message, not crash).

HOW TO VERIFY before finishing (from REPO root), running each ONCE: `corepack pnpm run typecheck`, `corepack pnpm run test`, `corepack pnpm run lint`, `corepack pnpm run build` — all exit 0. (Suite is deterministic; one run — do NOT loop it.) Write real Vitest tests for the report functions.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: make the changes in owned paths, then write ./notes.md in your task dir: what you read, files created/changed, commands run with results, the report semantics (FX conversion, expenses-positive, split handling, net-worth composition, over-time date scoping), and any Phase 10b (dashboard) follow-up.

HARD RULES: match the API signatures + conventions exactly (base currency; expenses positive; split-aware; net worth includes portfolio; over-time is date-scoped); reuse existing layers; do NOT edit db/stores; keep it typed and boring; keep the suite deterministic; do not touch files outside ownership; do not commit.
tasks.verified: A hidden contract test passes (spendingByCategory split-aware/expenses-only/FX; spendingByPayee; incomeVsExpenses; netWorth = base account balances + portfolio; netWorthOverTime date-scoped). The reports module exists with the exact API; ReportsPage reads the stores and renders Recharts charts for net worth (+over time), spending by category/payee, and income vs expenses. The Phase 9/5b/4/1 contract tests still pass; typecheck + suite + lint + build exit 0. Only owned paths changed; nothing committed.
